headline: A Canadian specialist in pharmaceutical water
lead: When an inspector asks who designed your water system, who welded it, who tested it and who services it now, your answer should be one company and a list of names. We design, fabricate, factory test, qualify and service Purified Water (PW), Water for Injection (WFI) and pure steam systems for plants inspected by Health Canada, the FDA or EU inspectors. We do that work in Canada, with one team, and nothing else. This page names that team, gives the company facts in one place, and shows where you can check each claim before you shortlist us.

blocks.h: Why a specialist, why Canadian, why one team
body: A Canadian plant that buys a pharmaceutical water system today usually chooses between three kinds of supplier. A large overseas manufacturer has the product depth, but sells into Canada through an agent or a sales office, runs the FAT on another continent and sends service engineers from abroad. A Canadian service company is close by, but services equipment it did not design or build. A general water treatment firm builds in Canada, but pharmaceutical water is one line among municipal, industrial and residential work.

Each of these can deliver a good system. Each also leaves a gap your team fills: a FAT you fly to, a design question nobody local can answer, a service call that waits for a visa, a validation package assembled from three suppliers' documents.

We set Aquemi up to close those gaps. We work only on high-purity water for regulated manufacturing. We design, weld, test, qualify and service in Canada, so your engineers can drive to the FAT and our technicians can drive to your plant. And one team carries your project from the user requirement specification (URS) to requalification, so the people who answer your auditor's questions are the people who made the decisions.

blocks.h: Questions to ask any pharmaceutical water supplier, and our answers
cols: Why your team should ask it
rows: Who designs the system, and where?
Design questions come back at FAT, IQ and every change after handover. A design team on another continent answers in another time zone
Our engineers in [engineering office, city and province], from your URS and a feed water analysis
Who welds the product-contact tubing, and who keeps the weld log?
Weld records are sampled at IQ and at supplier audits. Subcontracted welding adds a supplier your quality unit must qualify
Our welding operators, qualified to ASME Section IX, in our shop. Every product-contact weld is numbered and logged to ASME BPE, with EN 10204 3.1 material certificates by heat number
Where is the FAT run, and can we witness it without flying?

EU GMP Annex 15, 3.6 lets FAT tests stand at installation and operational qualification (IQ/OQ) without repeating them, where transport and installation do not affect them. A FAT your team saw is easier to leverage
In our test bay in [test bay location, city and province], wet, against a protocol you approved. [Remote witnessing: platform and terms]
Who executes IQ and OQ, and who approves the protocols?
If the supplier only delivers equipment, your validation team writes and runs everything
We write and execute the protocols; your quality unit approves them before execution and signs the reports
Is the pressure equipment registered for our province?
Under CSA B51, the province of installation must register the design with a Canadian registration number (CRN) before the equipment can be used. A foreign design can need changes to get one
Designed to CSA B51 from the start. [CRN route: Aquemi submits, or the certified vessel fabricator we use; provinces registered to date]
Who answers a service call, and from where?
Uptime after handover depends on travel time and parts on the shelf, not on the brochure
Our technicians, based in [service bases, cities], with parts stocked in [stock location or locations]. First on-site response within [severity 1 on-site response time, hours]
What crosses the border, and in which currency is the quote?
Import duty, customs brokerage, cross-border freight and exchange rate can all move after the purchase order

The assembled skid does not cross a border to reach a Canadian site. Quotes are in Canadian dollars. Components we import, such as membranes, electrodeionization (EDI) modules and some instruments, carry the duty that applies to them. [Confirm how imported content and its duty are stated in a quote]
Can we work and receive documents in French?
Operators, quality staff and, in Quebec, the law may need French documents
[Confirm which people work in French, and which documents are offered in French and how translations are reviewed]
Can we audit you, and speak to a client, before award?
Your quality unit has to qualify the supplier, not only the equipment
Yes. A remote or on-site supplier audit, a questionnaire pack, and a reference call where a client agrees

blocks.h: What changes when your water system is built and serviced in Canada
blocks.intro: Being Canadian is not a quality claim. It changes travel, registration, currency and response time, and each of those has a cost you can estimate.

items.t: A FAT you can drive to
items.d: Your engineers and quality staff witness the wet FAT in [test bay location, city and province], at [distance or travel time from the main Canadian pharmaceutical clusters]. More of your team attends, and a failed test point is retested the same week.

items.t: Registered for your province from the first drawing
items.d: Stills, pure steam generators and pressure-rated tanks are designed to CSA B51 so the CRN application does not send the design back for changes after award.
Chloramine disinfection, cold winter intakes and seasonal swings are design inputs for pretreatment and reverse osmosis (RO) sizing, not surprises at SAT.
No import of the assembled skid, no customs broker on the main shipment and no exchange rate clause on our own labour. [Confirm quoting terms and how imported components are priced]
Technicians based in [service bases, cities], spares held in [stock location or locations], and no work permit or border delay between a fault and a visit.

Quebec is one of Canada's main pharmaceutical and biotechnology manufacturing regions, and few high-purity water suppliers publish pharmaceutical content in French. [Confirm French-language engineering, service and documentation before publishing]

blocks.h: One team from URS to requalification

items.d: Process and automation engineers turn your URS and feed water analysis into the functional specification, piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs) and a requirements traceability matrix your validation team can follow.
Our welding operators build the skid and loop to ASME BPE, and every product-contact weld and heat number lands in the weld log as the work is done.
The engineers who wrote the functional specification run the wet FAT against the protocol you approved. Deviations are closed before the skid ships.

Our validation lead executes the site acceptance test (SAT), IQ and OQ with your team, and supports your performance qualification (PQ) sampling. [Confirm that the project lead stays named from proposal to handover]

Our service technicians take over with the as-built drawings, the FAT results and the people who made them one phone call away, for preventive maintenance, calibration, change control and requalification.

blocks.h: Questions engineering, quality and procurement teams ask

items.q: You are smaller than the global manufacturers. Why take the risk?
items.a: Judge the risk on evidence, not size. Audit our quality system, witness a FAT, read a sample turnover package and speak to a reference. A large supplier's size does not shorten your FAT travel, your service response or your CRN review. Ours lets the engineer who designed your system answer your auditor directly. [Add financial standing evidence offered to procurement, for example bank reference or bonding capacity]

items.q: What happens to our system if a key person leaves Aquemi?
items.a: The knowledge sits in the records, not in one person: the functional specification, the as-built drawings, the weld log, the FAT and qualification reports and the change history are in your turnover package and in our document control. A replacement engineer works from the same records your auditor reads.

items.q: Do you build WFI and pure steam, or only Purified Water?
items.a: Purified Water, WFI by distillation and by membrane, pure steam, and the storage and distribution loops that carry them. [Confirm the range of capacities Aquemi builds for each system, L/h or kg/h]

items.q: Do you work outside pharmaceutical manufacturing?
items.a: Our clients are pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device and contract manufacturers. The same RO and EDI platforms also serve hospital water for medical device reprocessing (CSA Z314), clinical laboratory reagent water (CLSI GP40) and laboratory water to ASTM D1193. [Confirm which adjacent uses Aquemi takes on] We do not sell residential or municipal products.

items.q: Do you service systems you did not build?
items.a: Yes, for [makes and equipment types serviced]. We start with a condition survey and a review of the drawings, qualification records and spares the system has. No Aquemi serial number is needed: log a service request with the make and model.
